Purchase criteria for fashion online shops in the United Kingdom in 2025
Share of respondents

Low prices 55%

29 Description: In a 2025 survey, 55 percent of responding British consumers stated that when it comes to fashion online shops, low prices are an important purchase criterion for them. Another 48 percent of consumers stated that free delivery is also important. Free
returns were important for 39 percent of respondents. Read more
Note(s): United Kingdom; 22 July 2025 to 30 July 2025; 1,249 respondents; 18-64 years
Source(s): Statista Consumer Insights
